name: Vilna
description: Vilna desktop integration: a Latin keyboard layout in password fields, Gloxi above other windows, Gloxi as a side panel of the Shell, the Vilna login screen, a VPN offer after the login page of a shared Wi-Fi, the Vilna colours of the dock with its transparency and springy icons, Vilna window motion, desktop widgets with MeteoAlarm weather warnings and a notification after an automatic rollback of an update.
